map.股价 / 每股账面价值 使用指南: Share Price / Book Value per Share User Guide
map.市净率（P/B）计算器：输入股价与每股账面价值 BVPS，求 P/B = 股价÷: Price-to-book (P/B) calculator: enter the share price and the book value per share BVPS to get P/B = price / BVPS, used to judge whether a stock is high or low in valuation.
map.P/B = 股价/每股账面价值: P/B = share price / book value per share
map.股价除以每股净资产，衡量市值相对账面价值的溢价。: Share price divided by net assets per share, measuring the market value premium over book value.
map.银行/重资产行业常用（资产可计量）。: Commonly used in banking and asset-heavy industries where assets are measurable.
map.破净（P/B<1）选股与价值陷阱识别。: Selecting below-book stocks (P/B < 1) and identifying value traps.
map.：P/B = 30/5 = 6。即市值 6 倍于每股净资产。: P/B = 30/5 = 6. That is, market value is 6 times book value per share.
map.：股价 4、BVPS 5：P/B=4/5=0.8 <1，市值低于账面（破净），需: With a share price of 4 and BVPS 5: P/B = 4/5 = 0.8 < 1, so market value is below book value (below book), and asset quality should be checked for hidden problems.
map.由主动收益序列求跟踪误差: Tracking error from an active return series
map.重资产、资产可可靠计量者（银行、地产、钢铁）适用；轻资产/科技股无形资产多，P/: Suits asset-heavy industries where assets can be reliably measured (banking, real estate, steel); for asset-light or tech companies with many intangibles, P/B is distorted.
map.P/B<1 一定便宜？: Does P/B Below 1 Always Mean Cheap?
map.未必。可能资产减值风险高、ROE 低。需结合 ROE：P/B 低但 ROE 也低: Not necessarily. There may be a high impairment risk and a low ROE. Read it together with ROE: a low P/B with a low ROE is not necessarily undervalued.
